newsitem.title: UK: European veg oils close lower despite Chicago.
newsitem.headline: European veg oils close lower despite Chicago.

text.p: European vegetable oil prices closed lower on Thursday despite early gains in Chicago.
Traders said buyers and sellers were continuing to watch the Chicago market but were not following its every moved.
The downside of palm oil remains limited by bullish fundamentals on the Malaysian market.
"The Malaysian market is on a roll at the moment with good exports and a forecast of near static stocks all of which is putting floor under palm oil," said a trader.
Euopean traders feel the market could turn again before the year end as tenders dry up owing to the high price of palm oil.
Crude palm oil cif Europe closed $2.50 to $5 down after Sep traded at $560 and $565, Oct and Oct/Dec at $560 and Jan/Mar at $555 a tonne cif.
In the refined oil sector RBD oil finished a tradeless session $2.50 down while olein was $2.50 lower to unchanged with no further business reported this afternoon.
Palm stearin was unchanged after Oct traded at $420 a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
Coconut oil closed $5 down with only a switch reported when afloat material traded at $740 in a swap with Sep/Oct at $720 a tonne cif.
Palmkernel oil closed mixed and tradeless with sellers $5 up to $2.50 down.
Soft oils attracted some light business before Chicago opened with 95 guilders paid for Sep soy oil, 95.50 for Oct and 96.50 and 96.75 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill for Nov/Jan.
Feb/Apr rape oil traded at 99 and 99.25 guilders.
Closing soy oil sellers were 0.75 to one guilder down and rape oil 0.75 to 0.50 guilders lower.
